title: What do the Liberal Democrats stand for?
gist: At the Brighton conference, Ed Davey's Lib Dems struggled to articulate a national purpose: More in Common finds over 60% of Britons don't know what they stand for, and their own voters like Prime Minister Andy Burnham. MPs split between out-devolving Burnham and attacking his mansion tax, while hung-parliament coalition dynamics pull the party between Labour and Conservative-leaning voters.
